name: Rejection Reason 63 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why a cancellation request has a rejected status.

REFE.name: Reference Rejection
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

CCIX.name: Client Collateral Instruction Identification
CCIX.definition: Unrecognised or invalid client collateral instruction identification.

CCTI.name: Client Collateral Transaction Identification
CCTI.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Client Collateral Transaction Identification.

IIND.name: Common Reference Rejection
IIND.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing common reference.

SAFA.name: Party A Safekeeping Account
SAFA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Party A Safekeeping Account

SAFB.name: Party B Safekeeping Account
SAFB.definition: Unrecognised or Invalid Party B Safekeeping Account.

DCAN.name: Rejected Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was rejected since the instruction has already been cancelled.

DPRG.name: Rejected Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Cancellation request has been rejected because the instruction process is in progress or has been processed.

RSET.name: Rejected Since Already Settled
RSET.definition: Cancellation request was rejected because the instruction was already settled.

RREP.name: Rejected Since Repo Ended
RREP.definition: Cancellation request was rejected because the repurchase was cancelled.

NRJN.name: Not Found Rejection For Cancellation Modification Or Termination
NRJN.definition: Cancellation, modification or termination request has been rejected since the instruction could not be found.
